decision.reason: The changelog line [ev-f92afdf0fcdc] says only that the formatting of Kubernetes events was fixed. It doesn't say which events, which component or configuration emits them, or what was wrong before. The linked PR's description is just the unfilled template with an empty release-note block [ev-8c98908907cf][ev-71c4a3c9c51d]. Its changed-files list shows a change only in pkg/operator/operator.go [ev-36b4a59c52c8], and the code diff isn't shown. To build an applicability condition, we would need that diff or a description of which events were badly formatted and when the operator emits them.
